latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — generate English subtitles for Bilibili videos via cloud AI and easy video upload.

- Upload Bilibili video files (up to 500MB; MP4, FLV, AVI, WebM supported) for automatic subtitle generation.
- AI quickly produces English captions and returns subtitled video files (usually 1-2 minutes per clip).
- No need for manual editing or software installation; all rendering happens on remote GPU servers.
- Easy session setup with free token (100 credits, 7-day expiry) granted on first use.
- Supports progress tracking, batch processing, and exporting in common video formats.
- Error handling for expired tokens, file limits, credits, and export issues is built-in for smooth workflow.
